scenario: A state unemployment-insurance agency processes a batch of new UI claims through a three-stage pipeline: (1) ingest and normalize the raw CSV batch of claimant records, (2) screen each claimant name against sanctions and duplicate-identity watchlists using AML/identity screening, and (3) produce a fraud-review release memo recommending Approve for Payment or Hold for SIU Review. The fraud-ring detection signal is the presence of multiple claims sharing the same bank-account routing number, ACH destination account, and device fingerprint within the submission window.
info_flow: csv-pipeline ingests and normalizes the raw claims batch CSV, outputting a cleaned claimant list → didit-aml-screening screens each claimant in the list against sanctions and identity watchlists, appending an aml_status field → reporting reads the screened list and cluster metadata to produce the fraud-review release memo.
